records.name: Peerlist
records.description: Peerlist Launchpad is a weekly product launch platform for developers, designers, and independent builders. Makers add a complete project to their profile before launching it to the Peerlist community.
records.editorialNote: Strong fit when the builder story matters alongside the product. The product submission is connected to a maker identity rather than an anonymous listing.
records.bestFor: Developer and designer products whose makers maintain a credible professional profile.
records.caveats: A verified individual profile and a 100% complete project are required before launching. Launchpad opens weekly on Monday, with scheduling available in advance.

pricing.notes: Peerlist documents a free project-creation and weekly Launchpad workflow for verified individual profiles.

records.domainRatingSource: Ahrefs API v3 public Domain Rating

records.name: MicroLaunch
records.description: Microlaunch provides a unique launch platform for makers & startups to distribute their products. Launch, get feedback and make first sales.
records.editorialNote: Useful as a focused launch experiment for indie products. Treat it as a chance to learn from a launch cohort rather than a guaranteed traffic source.
records.bestFor: Bootstrapped and early-stage products that benefit from a smaller recurring launch community.

pricing.notes: Reported by a public source list; confirm current pricing with the destination.

link.notes: 132/132 sampled external homepage links did not use rel=nofollow or rel=sponsored on 2026-07-14; individual listing tiers may differ.
